title: Grand Theology Integration Wave — Presence, Access, Life & Restoration
purpose: Route the project's accumulated biblical, theological, chronological and ethical material into one coherent grand synthesis while also exposing exactly what overlaps, when it appeared, when the comparison was discovered, how it is classified and where the evidence lives.

current_overlap_census.rule: node count measures registered comparative relations, not fulfilled prophecies, unique Bible verses or statistically independent evidence

master_question: How can life participate in divine presence after rupture, and how is access restored without erasing differentiated persons, roles, places and functions?
canonical_arc: Presence → rupture → guarded access → covenantal mediation → House/Temple/Zion → prophetic restoration → Christ as Presence/Temple/Door/Way → death/new living Way → Spirit-distributed presence → Body/House/Temple community → New Jerusalem → open gates + River + Tree + healing + no curse
project_parallel: Father/Source/House → Spirit/flow → Son/Door/Way → world/embodiment → ordeal/death/history → return through relation → House/Garden/Tree → fruit/healing/repair
major_promotions: Move biblical interpretation from motif-counting toward operator/function analysis.
Give the reader an exact, versioned overlap census rather than vague claims of many/hundreds of parallels.
Separate overlap-node count from unique-verse count, book breadth, dated project-attestations and countertext count.
Use two-date provenance where possible: project-side attestation date versus archive discovery/comparison date.
Measure temporal independence and genealogical dependence so later Bible-influenced Tim statements are not miscounted as independent coincidences.
Treat Access as a first-class theological category joining Eden guardians, sanctuary boundaries, Door/Way, Hebrews and New Jerusalem.
Treat House, Tree/Vine, Body, Temple and City as distinct images solving the one-and-many problem through integrated plurality.
Track role transfer across the canon: theological functions can move from sacred place to person to community to city/creation without the carriers becoming identical.
Track canonical reversals: guarded Tree access → restored Tree; exile → civic participation; curse → no curse; restricted inner sanctuary → city-scale divine presence.
Treat the River as source-to-world generativity: a sacred center is tested by outward life, fruit and healing.
Treat Gardener/Shepherd/service as ethical criteria of Throne/Father/source claims.
Treat ascent as incomplete until revelation descends/flows outward into manifestation, service and repair.
Make countertexts first-class: role mismatches and opposite-valence uses strengthen the research by preventing overfit.
Require consequential English word correspondences to survive original-language checking before treating them as lexical unity.
fresh_microcosms: Ephesians 2:11-22: alienation → nearness → wall broken → reconciliation → access to Father through Spirit → citizens/household → cornerstone → temple/dwelling.
Hebrews 6:19-20: hope as anchor entering behind veil where Jesus is forerunner; positive target-anchor corrects purely restrictive anchor/leash readings.
Psalm 118: distress/spacious place → life → gates of righteousness → rejected stone/cornerstone.
Exodus 25:17-22: exactly two cherubim at opposite ends + central meeting/presence zone; a tighter paired-guardian comparator for the April 9 project architecture than Genesis 3 alone.
Psalm 80: Shepherd/Joseph/flock + cherubim throne + shining/restoration + bread/tears/mockery + vine/root/branches + mountain/river + wall + right-hand/son-of-man/name/salvation in one psalm.
Isaiah 58: care for vulnerable people → light → watered garden → foundations → Repairer of the Breach / Restorer of paths.
Ezekiel 34: self-feeding shepherds versus strengthening/healing/seeking/protecting the flock; leadership evaluated by vulnerable participants.
Luke 15: restorative return to Father/House provides the opposite pole to Dog→vomit regressive return.
Revelation 3:20 and 22:17: Door/access theology expands into invitation, response, shared meal and freely offered water of life.
Daniel 7: throne-giver, Son-of-Man figure and holy community remain related but differentiated.
Philippians 2: non-grasping service/descent/death precede exaltation, constraining simple supremacy readings.
Noah vessel versus Covenant Ark: English 'ark' obscures different Hebrew terms/functions, requiring a preservation-vessel versus covenant-presence distinction.

role_matrix.Father: source / builder / gardener / giver / throne-presence / responsibility
role_matrix.Son: manifestation / Temple-body / Door / Way / Vine / stone / Lamb / mediated access / suffering passage
role_matrix.Spirit: living water / breath-wind / renewal / distributed presence / animation
role_matrix.community: branches / body members / field / building / temple / living stones / assembly / flock
role_matrix.city_creation: dwelling / open gates / River / Tree / healing nations / no curse

integrated_plurality: House/household, Vine/Tree, Body, Temple/living stones, flock and City are distinct participation grammars. Their shared lesson is unity-with-difference, not center-totalization.
strongest_countertexts: Hebrews 3 distinguishes builder, House, servant and Son-over-House.
Psalm 24 identifies YHWH as King of Glory.
Ephesians 2 makes reconciliation and peace integral to House/Temple/access theology.
Ezekiel 34 condemns leaders who feed themselves while neglecting weak/lost/injured members.
Philippians 2 makes non-grasping service and descent prior to exaltation.
Deuteronomy 17 places the king under law rather than above it.
Revelation keeps Father-name, Lamb/Son, throne, city and people differentiated.
Revelation's positive equal-dimension city prevents cube=evil as a universal rule.
Isaiah/Luke leveling prevents high=good / low=bad as a universal rule.
Hosea's cords of love and Hebrews' hope-anchor prevent cord/anchor/leash=evil as a universal rule.
The Son's remembered reciprocal/karma rhetoric diverges from canonical enemy-love/non-retaliation teaching.
research_next: Compute normalized unique Bible reference and book counts directly from the registry rather than estimating them manually.
Recover exact February 9 and May 28 conversation text/timestamps and upgrade provenance where possible.
Apply the measurement dimensions P/E/T/D/R/S/C/I to the highest-density nodes and publish the component values rather than only one strength class.
Build a visual chronology with project date and discovery date on separate tracks.
Add Jewish, early-Christian/patristic and later mystical reception-history layers without merging them into biblical primary text.
Expand original-language audits for high-stakes word correspondences such as House, Door/Gate, Spirit/breath, Root/Branch, throne/seat, ark/vessel and anointed/messiah.
Keep growing the countertext corpus in parallel with positive overlaps.
